title: Lightly Spiced Tunisian Lamb Tagine
description: A rich and aromatic one-pot dish featuring lamb, Thai chilli jam, and kombu-cold-extract, all perfectly balanced for a refreshing and flavorful meal.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a 3-quart clay or ceramic tagine over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook, stirring occasionally, until softened and lightly caramelized, about 15 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook, stirring constantly, for 1 minute.
Add the lamb shoulder and cook, browning on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Add the cumin, coriander, cinnamon, and black pepper. Cook for 1 minute.
Add the Thai chilli jam and cook, stirring to combine, for 2 minutes.
Add the kombu and cook, stirring to combine, for 2 minutes.
Add 1 cup of water and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, until the lamb is tender and the meat is easily shredded with a fork, about 1 hour and 30 minutes.
Season with flaky sea salt to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley if desired.
